claim: Kenya RCT (Dupas & Robinson, AEJ Applied 2013): interest-free savings accounts offered to market vendors (mostly women) and bicycle-taxi drivers (men). 41% of the treatment group actively used the account (13% refused, 40% opened but never deposited); mean deposits Ksh 2,840 for women vs Ksh 1,290 for men; market women raised business investment ~38-60%; NO impact for bicycle-taxi drivers

Caveats: Kenya not India; the vendor/driver contrast is confounded with gender (women vendors vs men drivers); small sample; bank account not an app. AEA page: https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257%2Fapp.5.1.163.
